name: Mercenary Charge
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Charge (players/paladin/mercenary/charge_merc.sval, 18 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 6 (in brackets): dash speed 12 for 0.19 s (16 for 0.2 s). Its own mana 30 (25), cooldown 0.25 s. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon.
summary: Charge on a shorter, slower dash: still 75 physical damage and a 0.5 s stun.
